# Fixtures

## `assembly-cube-output.golden.json`

Proves that with `uVelocity` at 0 the cubes are byte-identical to develop at 1b1694e (before the scroll-velocity PR). It holds, for all eight bundle kinds at keep 1 and 0.5, the sha256 of every attribute the vertex program reads, plus the full uniform set (as JSON) and the sha256 of both shader programs.

It is a record of develop, not of the current tree. Do not regenerate it to make a failing test pass. A failure means the resting cubes changed.

The vertex digest is of the program with every line containing `uVelocity` removed (`assembly-velocity.test.ts` does the same before hashing), so the velocity lines can change without touching the file. Regenerate it only when the resting look is changed on purpose, and say so in the PR.

To regenerate, on a tree whose resting output is the one you want to record (for the original, `git checkout 1b1694e`):

1. Save the script below as `apps/web/tests/unit/zz-capture.test.ts`.
2. In `apps/web`, run `npx vitest run tests/unit/zz-capture.test.ts`.
3. Delete the script. Never commit it.

If you capture from a tree that already has velocity lines, drop them from `VERTEX` before hashing, as in step above: `VERTEX.split('\n').filter((l) => !l.includes('uVelocity')).join('\n')`, and delete `uVelocity` from the uniforms.

```ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { it } from 'vitest'
import { assemblyBuilder } from '@/lib/assembly/bundle-cache'
import { instanceCount } from '@/lib/assembly/targets'
import { createAssemblyUniforms } from '@/components/three/AssemblyMaterial'
import { FRAGMENT, VERTEX } from '@/components/three/assembly.glsl'

const sha = (v: string | Float32Array): string =>
  createHash('sha256').update(typeof v === 'string' ? v : Buffer.from(v.buffer, v.byteOffset, v.byteLength)).digest('hex')

it('captures', () => {
  const kinds = ['cloud', 'monolith', 'stream', 'lattice', 'orbit', 'scatter', 'grid', 'ring'] as const
  const bundles: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {}
  for (const keep of [1, 0.5]) {
    for (const kind of kinds) {
      const b = assemblyBuilder(instanceCount(keep), keep)(kind)
      bundles[`${keep}:${kind}`] = {
        count: b.count, position: sha(b.position), colT: sha(b.colT), colour: sha(b.colour), live: sha(b.live),
        seed: sha(b.seed), spin: sha(b.spin), flow: sha(b.flow), fall: sha(b.fall), rot: b.rot, tilt: b.tilt,
      }
    }
  }
  const out = { bundles, uniforms: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(createAssemblyUniforms())), vertex: sha(VERTEX), fragment: sha(FRAGMENT) }
  writeFileSync('tests/fixtures/assembly-cube-output.golden.json', JSON.stringify(out, null, 2) + '\n')
})
```

## `assembly-bundles.golden.json`

Digests of the bundles from before the model slot; used by `assembly-targets.test.ts`.

## `cube.glb`

A 2 kB fixture for the model e2e, generated by `make-cube-glb.ts`.
